QuestionStmt.S: The volume of the tetrahedron whose co-terminus edges are $\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}$ is 12 cubic units. If the scalar projection of $\vec{a}$ on $\vec{b} \times \vec{c}$ is 4, then $|\vec{b} \times \vec{c}| =$

Solution.S:
Volume of tetrahedron = $\frac{1}{6}[\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}] = 12$.
Thus $[\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}] = 72$.
But $[\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}] = \vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} \times \vec{c}) = 72$.

Scalar projection of $\vec{a}$ on $\vec{b} \times \vec{c}$ is $\frac{\vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} \times \vec{c})}{|\vec{b} \times \vec{c}|} = 4$.
Substituting: $\frac{72}{|\vec{b} \times \vec{c}|} = 4 \Rightarrow |\vec{b} \times \vec{c}| = \frac{72}{4} = 18$.

Hence the correct option is A: 18.
